Additionally, the actual response omits the polite closing question ("¿En qué más te puedo ayudar hoy?") that is present in the reference. According to the rubric, a "Hard Close" (Actual) vs. a "Courtesy Check" (Reference) is considered a Minor Deviation, leading to a Score 3.
